lines: Our projection gives him a 15% chance to play Week 11. Shanahan said he may return to practice Thursday, but Sunday's status is undecided.

If he plays, SF faces MIN, who allows the 28th-most PPR points per game to WRs. SF's implied team total is 24.8 points.
